public_rationale: The record shows both strong agent benchmark performance and weaknesses on naturally specified or ambiguous tasks. Neither establishes the broad claim. A high overall task score does not isolate intent understanding; bugs and missing features do not prove misunderstanding. CLARITY tests ambiguity more directly but supplies no general standard for sufficient assistant reliability. Without a matching decisive evaluation, the undated forecast remains open.
limitations: Different applications can tolerate very different error rates.
Synthetic user interactions do not fully substitute for independently confirmed real-user intentions.
The evidence concerns particular original-GPT-5 settings and cannot automatically be extended to every agent design.
